page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core. A key hardware feature is its bundled local storage, consisting of 7679 GB of SSD capacity. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core CPU performance, as measured by stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the weak category, and single-threaded gzip compression is poor. However, multi-core performance is average, with competitive scores in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory read and write bandwidths remain in the average tier, though overall Passmark memory scores are weak. Database operations and Redis SET operations both perform at average levels.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.i2.8xlarge offers high qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring substantial local storage and memory without needing top-tier single-threaded compute performance. The massive 7679 GB SSD local storage makes it highly suitable for storage-intensive applications, large-scale databases, and data-caching layers. The 256 GB memory capacity supports memory-bound tasks, while the dedicated 32 vCPUs handle concurrent multi-threaded workloads such as web serving and parallel data processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.8xlarge is an x86_64 server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of RAM. It features a substantial 7679 GB of bundled local SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. Benchmark data reveals weak single-core CPU performance, but average multi-core CPU and memory bandwidth capabilities. The server demonstrates average performance in database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving. Given its high storage capacity and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, the ecs.i2.8xlarge is qualitatively cost-efficient for storage-heavy and memory-intensive workloads. It is well-suited for databases, data caching, and multi-threaded general-purpose applications, though it is less optimal for single-threaded compute tasks.
